topics.name: Multimodal reasoning and visual grounding
topics.summary: Across image-text reasoning, OCT interpretation, video affect, and hazard analysis, these studies turn visual evidence into explicit relations or saliency cues and test where multimodal models lose grounding. Controlled evaluations show that structured evidence and better perception can reduce unsupported answers.

topics.name: Long-horizon agent memory and tool orchestration
topics.summary: Agent platforms for code, science, navigation, and reporting treat memory as reusable skills or budgeted context, combine planning with tools, and test persistent workflows. Results emphasize editable artifacts, selective retrieval, and execution feedback as the main levers for dependable long tasks.

topics.name: Legal and evidence-grounded retrieval
topics.summary: Legal, scientific, ontology, and industrial QA systems combine retrieval, formal policy constraints, and calibrated generation. Experiments compare adaptive pipelines, private vector compression, and point-in-time evidence, showing that traceable context selection matters more than fluent answers alone.

topics.name: Executable software and hardware verification
topics.summary: Requirements reconstruction, hardware closure, solver-model checking, dependency-aware code generation, process planning, and cost accounting studies test generated artifacts against executable constraints. Their shared finding is that intermediate structure and falsification expose silent errors that pass surface-level syntax checks.

topics.name: Efficient training and adaptation of neural models
topics.summary: These works reduce training or adaptation cost with function-preserving graph surgery, forward-mode gradients, topology-aware parameter selection, low-rank modality routing, and speculative decoding. Across language, vision, and large residual networks, preserving useful representations while allocating computation selectively is the recurring strategy.

topics.name: Model-based reinforcement learning and predictive control
topics.summary: Model-based control studies use world feedback, action-conditioned simulators, formation dynamics, rendezvous constraints, robust planning, and entropy-aware policy updates. Tests in robotics, orbital operations, and nonlinear systems indicate that explicit dynamics and information before commitment provide safer exploration than internal uncertainty proxies alone.

topics.name: Robot navigation, manipulation, and social motion
topics.summary: Navigation and manipulation systems combine UWB or visual localization, socially aware multi-agent trajectories, pose estimation, contact handling, and impedance or MPC-style execution. Simulated and physical evaluations focus on recovery from failures, human-aware motion, and robust behavior under changing scenes.

topics.name: 3D shape and scene reconstruction
topics.summary: 3D studies make editing, Gaussian splatting, scene reconstruction, point-cloud distance, and asset generation more compact or topology aware. Across meshes and videos, structural priors and explicit geometric representations improve novel-view quality, motion robustness, and editable shape control.

topics.name: Diffusion generation and visual editing
topics.summary: Diffusion models are adapted for MRI enhancement, semi-supervised conditional synthesis, object removal, concept suppression, identity-preserving edits, and text-to-video preference control. The common pattern is to steer generation with masks, labels, low-rank residuals, or semantic constraints while limiting collateral changes.

topics.name: Clinical imaging and decision support
topics.summary: Clinical systems use multimodal records, self-supervised or federated representations, semi-supervised segmentation, radiology and pathology imagery, survival outcomes, and audio health cues. Evaluations report gains from combining heterogeneous signals, but also expose calibration and generalization limits across institutions and patient groups.

topics.name: Audio representation and affective speech
topics.summary: Audio studies cover singing quality, anomalous domestic sounds, noisy self-supervision, speech emotion, driver facial cues, and interpretable health assessment. Temporal scoring, denoising representations, and compact models improve robustness while preserving links between acoustic events and human-centered labels.

topics.name: Generative recommendation and ranking
topics.summary: Recommendation work uses autoregressive decoding tries, semantic tokenization, and agent-era system perspectives to address candidate generation and post-click prediction. The papers emphasize efficient discrete representations and adaptive ranking as recommender interfaces move toward language-model control.

topics.name: Forecasting nonstationary environmental and operational signals
topics.summary: Forecasting studies model seasonal ocean variables, fuel moisture, time-varying networks, traffic or health trajectories, and maintenance outcomes. They combine progressive information scaling, hybrid sequence models, and counterfactual or survival views to handle drift, sparse observations, and long horizons.

topics.name: Graph message passing and network learning
topics.summary: Graph research examines depth limits in sparse message passing, intuitionistic fuzzy multi-view learning, supply-chain metamodels, and relational tracking. The analyses connect spectral structure and relational features to when deeper propagation helps, how uncertainty is represented, and how decentralized decisions scale.

topics.name: Statistical learning and uncertainty theory
topics.summary: Theoretical and methodological papers study explanation stability, bootstrap failure, conformal calibration, causal conditions, nonlinear PDE inference, physically supported inverse problems, and entropy estimation. Together they replace single scores with explicit assumptions, finite-sample guarantees, or falsification tests.

topics.name: Security, privacy, and trustworthy AI operations
topics.summary: Privacy fairness, secure component selection, public model ecosystems, offensive language, incident prioritization, and governance studies examine deployment risks. Differential privacy, interviews, red-team analysis, and operational monitoring show that protection must cover data access, model supply chains, and downstream use rather than only model outputs.

topics.name: Remote sensing and physical scene understanding
topics.summary: Remote and physical sensing papers apply ML to diffraction, combustion, SAR, clouds, UAV intersections, and annotation selection. Foundation-assisted labeling and multimodal scene reasoning improve coverage, while synthetic fog and risk annotations make safety validation more realistic.

topics.name: Cognitive architectures and open-ended agent evolution
topics.summary: These conceptual and empirical studies connect algebraic or developmental cognitive architectures with value learning and open-ended agent evolution. Comparisons of symbolic components, emotion-oriented designs, constraint selection, and fitness-free platforms ask how persistent structure and social values can emerge without opaque end-to-end training.

topics.name: Physical design, materials, and energy systems
topics.summary: Materials and engineering studies use kirigami structures, semantic-physics design, battery sensing, and wireless optimization to connect learned models with physical constraints. Their applications favor interpretable geometry, virtual sensing, and resource-aware designs that can be validated against real devices or environments.

topics.name: Wireless and edge intelligence
topics.summary: Wireless learning work studies foundation models for multi-task optimization and federated or networked inference under constrained links. The shared focus is allocating communication and computation while preserving task quality in heterogeneous 5G and mobile settings.

topics.name: Benchmarks for human-centered AI
topics.summary: Benchmark papers measure athlete decision support, depression screening, generated-video quality, and operations-research reasoning with task-specific datasets and structured evaluation. They show that deployment-oriented metrics and realistic user or domain context reveal weaknesses hidden by generic accuracy scores.

topics.name: Travel and autonomous transport planning
topics.summary: Travel and road-safety studies validate itineraries with persona simulations, estimate articulated vehicle geometry, and model pedestrian behavior for autonomous-vehicle testing. Their common contribution is to evaluate plans against varied users and traffic participants instead of treating a route as an isolated output.

topics.name: Robust visual recognition under degradation
topics.summary: Animal re-identification, class-agnostic counting, and incremental face-forgery detection address blur, compression, regional imbalance, and changing data streams. Low-rank distillation, spatial evidence, and replay selection improve identity or count reliability when visual quality and class frequencies shift.

topics.name: Combinatorial optimization and robust decision models
topics.summary: Facility location, evolutionary constrained optimization, truckload pricing, chance-constrained planning, and nonstationary bandits study decisions under uncertainty and operational limits. Structural classifications, augmented Lagrangians, dual prices, and entropy bounds provide tractable policies with explicit robustness guarantees.
